kashika: फलसाधनयोग्यः पदार्थो लोके हेतुरुच्यते। तद्वाचिनस्तृतीया विभक्तिर्भवति। धनेन कुलम्। कन्यया शोकः। विद्यया यशः॥
kashikaEnglish: The cause (hetu) takes instrumental: विद्यया यशः 'fame through learning', धनेन कुलम् 'family through wealth'.
englishFull:
A word denoting cause (हेतु) takes the 3rd case-affix (instrumental).

**Examples:**
| Expression | Meaning |
|------------|---------|
| विद्यया यशः | "fame through learning" |
| धनेन कुलम् | "family [prestige] through wealth" |
| कन्यया शोकः | "grief because of a daughter" |

हेतु here is the popular sense (cause), not the grammatical हेतु (@ref[1.4.55]).
